name: Environment refresh recovery
trigger: DEVL refreshed (or about to be) from PROD

steps.name: Notice
steps.means: Triage sees an environment refresh coming; master asks what it will wipe.

steps.name: List in-flight work
steps.means: The client agent lists the work in flight that the refresh will wipe.
steps.gate: result lists what the refresh wipes

steps.name: Confirm to QAD
steps.means: Ben confirms the refresh timing with QAD.
steps.gate: Ben confirms the timing with QAD

steps.name: Restore setup
steps.means: The client agent puts the setup back after the refresh.

steps.name: Re-verify
steps.means: The client agent checks against the data that everything works again; that closes the case.

spec.question: After the restore in task {prev}, does each item it restored work again in DEVL? One line per item.
